files.README.md:
# Wexbridge Testing Services - fee schedule

Fees are reviewed each January and the schedule is reissued.
The conditions of testing sit alongside the schedule.
files.conditions.txt:
Priority surcharge: 25 per cent of the listed fee applies to any test started within two working days of the sample arriving at the laboratory.
Fees in the schedule are quoted per sample.
Reports are sent by email at no extra charge.
